title: Design System: La Ruche by InovElite

display.purpose: Hero H1 only; second clause in blue-soft on its own line.

title.purpose: Step titles in the 01-04 sequence; tier and timeline titles on the same ladder.

title-sm.purpose: Feature titles, FAQ questions, room options, tabs.

figure.purpose: Money and count heroes with tabular numerals: report amount, tier quota, growth figure, day counter.

wordmark.purpose: LA RUCHE, uppercase; closing frame scales it to 6.75rem with the blue-white glow.

lead.purpose: The one paragraph under each H2, muted, 34-40rem.

label.purpose: Buttons, pills, chips, nav links, field labels.

data-label.purpose: Uppercase tabular labels inside instruments only (caption actor tag, request type, ledger heads); never above a section heading.

shadows.name: demo-glow
shadows.purpose: Red light under the demo pill (brand exception from the launch film).

shadows.name: closing-wordmark-glow
shadows.purpose: Blue-white halo on the closing LA RUCHE wordmark (brand exception).

shadows.name: cell-light
shadows.purpose: Hub and core hexagons; light emitted by lit cells. Pulses to 46px / 0.85 in the gather finale.

shadows.name: signed-cell-light
shadows.purpose: Signed configuration cells in the monthly report.

shadows.name: packet-light
shadows.purpose: Travelling packet dots on arcs and beams.

shadows.name: paper-drop
shadows.purpose: The white quote sheet lying on the night.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Field focus and focus-within on the hero email pill; actor pills use 4px at 0.22.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Global :focus-visible; white on the demo button.

shadows.name: header-glass
shadows.value: background: rgba(7, 10, 31, 0.82); backdrop-filter: saturate(140%) blur(14px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(127, 160, 255, 0.14)

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for movement, reveals and glow.

motion.name: dur-fast
motion.purpose: Colour, border and background changes; button press.

motion.name: cell-breathe
motion.value: filter brightness 1 -> 1.28 -> 1, 2.4s (rooms 3s, per-cell phase), ease-in-out, infinite

motion.name: packets-in
motion.purpose: Packet clusters travelling along pathLength=100 arcs.

motion.name: core-pulse
motion.purpose: Gather core once all sources have arrived.

motion.name: hive-cycle
motion.purpose: Idle hero cycling through actor flows.

motion.name: hive-parallax
motion.purpose: Hero hive lowering with scroll (desktop camera).

motion.name: stamp-land
motion.purpose: Devis pret stamp on the quote.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation/transition 0.01ms, packets and beams removed, tier beam hidden, canvas drawn as one lit still with parked packets, counters at final values

components.name: Demo Button
components.description: The only red control; every demo or pilot request.
components.html: Demander une démo
components.css: .ds-btn-signal { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 1.5rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--signal-strong, #e5174b); color: #fff; font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.005em; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -12px rgba(255, 45, 85, 0.65), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18); transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 560ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 180ms linear; } .ds-btn-signal svg { transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-signal:hover { background: var(--signal-deep, #c80f3c); box-shadow: 0 14px 38px -10px rgba(255, 45, 85, 0.75), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18); } .ds-btn-signal:hover svg { transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-btn-signal:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-signal:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 1.5rem; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(127, 160, 255, 0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(127, 160, 255, 0.3); color: var(--ink, #f2f5ff); font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 180ms linear, border-color 180ms linear, color 180ms linear, transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(127, 160, 255, 0.12); border-color: var(--blue-soft, #7fa0ff); color: #fff; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ice, #c9d6ff); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Actor Pills
components.description: Real buttons anchored over hive cells; the Vous pill is the one red actor.
components.css: .ds-actors { display: flex; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 1.5rem; background: #04061a; } .ds-actor { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 34px; padding: 0 0.85rem 0 0.7rem; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(7, 10, 31, 0.74); border: 1px solid rgba(127, 160, 255, 0.3); color: var(--ice, #c9d6ff); font: 550 0.82rem Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; backdrop-filter: blur(6px); transition: border-color 180ms linear, color 180ms linear, background-color 180ms linear, box-shadow 560ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-actor__dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #7fa0ff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(127, 160, 255, 0.18); } .ds-actor:hover, .ds-actor:focus-visible { color: #fff; border-color: #7fa0ff; background: rgba(21, 29, 74, 0.9); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(43, 89, 255, 0.22); outline: none; } .ds-actor--you { color: #fff; border-color: rgba(255, 45, 85, 0.6); } .ds-actor--you .ds-actor__dot { background: #ff2d55; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 45, 85, 0.25); } .ds-actor--you:hover, .ds-actor--you:focus-visible { border-color: #ff2d55; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(255, 45, 85, 0.22); }

components.name: Hex Cells (lit and unlit)
components.description: The structural unit; lit cells breathe to signal state.
components.css: .ds-cells { display: flex; gap: 6px; padding: 1.5rem; background: #0a0f2c; } .ds-hex { width: 40px; height: 46px; clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 25%, 100% 75%, 50% 100%, 0 75%, 0 25%); background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1b2459, #121941); } .ds-hex.is-lit { background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--blue-hi, #4f75ff), var(--blue, #2b59ff)); animation: ds-breathe 2.4s cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-breathe { 50% { filter: brightness(1.28); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-hex.is-lit { animation: none; } }

components.name: Light Arc with Packets
components.description: Dotted pathLength=100 track with a three-dot packet cluster travelling toward the receiver.
components.html: <svg class="ds-arc-demo" viewBox="0 0 320 120" aria-hidden="true"><path class="ds-arc" pathLength="100" d="M20 100 Q160 -20 300 100"/><path class="ds-arc ds-arc--packets" pathLength="100" d="M20 100 Q160 -20 300 100"/></svg>
components.css: .ds-arc-demo { width: 320px; height: 120px; background: #04061a; overflow: visible; } .ds-arc { fill: none; stroke-linecap: round; stroke: rgba(127, 160, 255, 0.55); stroke-width: 2; stroke-dasharray: 0 3.2; } .ds-arc--packets { stroke: #fff; stroke-width: 3.5; stroke-dasharray: 0 2.6 0 2.6 0 2.6 0 92.2; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(127, 160, 255, 0.9)); animation: ds-packets 1.8s linear infinite; } @keyframes ds-packets { from { stroke-dashoffset: 100; } to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-arc--packets { animation: none; } }

components.css: .ds-request { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.9rem; max-width: 22rem; padding: 1rem 1.15rem; border-radius: 16px; background: rgba(21, 29, 74, 0.92); border: 1px solid rgba(127, 160, 255, 0.3); font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-request__well { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 42px; height: 42px; flex: none; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(43, 89, 255, 0.2); color: var(--ice, #c9d6ff); } .ds-request__body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.1rem; } .ds-request__label { font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--blue-soft, #7fa0ff); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-request__title { font-weight: 600; color: #fff; } .ds-request__meta { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--muted, #a3add3); }

components.css: .ds-quote { width: min(100%, 440px); padding: 1.1rem 1.15rem 1rem; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--paper, #fff); color: var(--paper-ink, #0a0f2c); box-shadow: 0 40px 70px -30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4); transform: rotate(-1.2deg); font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-quote__head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding-bottom: 0.7rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #e4e8f1; font-family: Poppins, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; } .ds-quote__head span { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; color: #4b5578; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-quote__table { width: 100%; margin-top: 0.4rem; font-size: 0.78rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; border-collapse: collapse; } .ds-quote__table th, .ds-quote__table td { padding: 0.36rem 0.2rem; text-align: left; font-weight: 550; } .ds-quote__table td { text-align: right; color: #0b7a55; font-weight: 600; } .ds-quote__table tbody tr + tr { border-top: 1px solid #e4e8f1; } .ds-quote__table tfoot th, .ds-quote__table tfoot td { border-top: 2px solid #0a0f2c; font-weight: 700; } .ds-quote__foot { margin-top: 0.7rem; display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; } .ds-quote__stamp { font-family: Poppins, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.82rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #0b7a55; border: 2px solid #0b7a55; border-radius: 8px; padding: 0.25rem 0.55rem; transform: rotate(-7deg); }

components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.4rem; max-width: 22rem; font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field > span { font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 550; color: var(--ink, #f2f5ff); } .ds-field__req { color: var(--signal-text, #ff6b86); } .ds-field input { min-height: 50px; padding: 0.75rem 0.95rem; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(127, 160, 255, 0.3); background: var(--night-950, #04061a); color: var(--ink, #f2f5ff); font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; transition: border-color 180ms linear, box-shadow 180ms linear; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #8892bb; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: rgba(127, 160, 255, 0.5); } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--blue-soft, #7fa0ff); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(43, 89, 255, 0.25); } .ds-field input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--signal-text, #ff6b86); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 45, 85, 0.15); }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1.5rem; height: 72px; padding: 0 1.5rem; background: rgba(7, 10, 31, 0.82); backdrop-filter: saturate(140%) blur(14px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(127, 160, 255, 0.14); font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-wordmark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; color: var(--ink, #f2f5ff); text-decoration: none; } .ds-wordmark__text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; line-height: 1; } .ds-wordmark__name { font-family: Poppins, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.15rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-wordmark__by { margin-top: 0.22rem; font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--muted, #a3add3); } .ds-nav__links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; } .ds-nav__links a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 42px; padding: 0 0.85rem; border-radius: 999px; color: var(--muted, #a3add3); font-size: 0.94rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: color 180ms linear, background-color 180ms linear; } .ds-nav__links a:hover, .ds-nav__links a[aria-current="true"] { color: var(--ink, #f2f5ff); background: rgba(127, 160, 255, 0.08); } .ds-nav__links a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c9d6ff; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav__links .ds-nav__cta { margin-left: 0.6rem; padding: 0 1.1rem; background: #e5174b; color: #fff; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -12px rgba(255, 45, 85, 0.65); } .ds-nav__links .ds-nav__cta:hover { background: #c80f3c; color: #fff; }

narrative.overview:
Every surface is the launch film's night: a deep navy honeycomb where electric-blue light lives inside cells and travels between them along dotted arcs. Information is light. When something is known, available or done, its cell lights and breathes; when it moves from one actor to another, a cluster of bright packets runs along a dotted arc. Exactly one cell in the world is red, and it is always "Vous", the reseller. The only other red thing is the button that asks for a demo.

Density is calm and editorial: wide night sections (up to 10.5rem of vertical rhythm), one idea per section, asymmetric two-column compositions, and dense data only inside its own instruments (the quote sheet, the ledger, the monthly report). Depth comes from stepping between navy tones and from emitted light, not from lifted cards. The single paper surface in the world is the white quote sheet and the documents it produces; everything else stays in the night.

Type pairs the film's own faces: Poppins carries headlines, figures and the wordmark; Inter carries reading text and data, with tabular figures for every count, time and amount.
keyCharacteristics: Navy ground in four steps (#04061a to #151d4a); electric blue is light, never fill-for-fill's-sake.
The pointy-top hexagon is the structural unit for actors, kit items, quotas, steps, badges, rooms and bullets.
Lit, breathing cells are the state signal; dim cells are potential.
Dotted arcs with travelling packet clusters are the grammar of information flow.
One red cell (Vous) and one red action (the demo); nothing else is red by choice.
Pills act, cells mean: interactive controls are pills, meaning-bearing units are hexagons.

rules.name: The One Red Cell Rule
rules.body: Red belongs to "Vous" and to the demo action, nowhere else. Status, alerts, deadlines, "now" markers, cost bars and day counters are blue, ice or muted; the build moved every one of them off red. Red fills on controls use `signal-strong` (#E5174B), never `signal`, because the button text must pass AA.

rules.name: The Ice Is Data Rule
rules.body: Values, labels inside instruments and pill text use `ice`, not white; white (`#fff`) is reserved for headlines, lit-cell glyphs and emphasised figures.

rules.name: The Only Paper Rule
rules.body: White surfaces exist only as the quote sheet and the documents it generates. No other white card, panel or section.

rules.name: The Film Pairing Rule
rules.body: Poppins for headlines, figures and the wordmark; Inter for everything read. No third face.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every timestamp, counter, quote line, amount and quota uses tabular numerals so values do not jitter as they animate or align in columns.

rules.name: The Light Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Glow is emitted only by things that are lit in the world (cells, hubs, packets, the growth line). On interface chrome, exactly two glows are allowed: red under the demo pill and blue-white on the closing wordmark.

dos: **Do** make every new unit of meaning (an actor, an item, a step, a quota, a status) a pointy-top hexagon, and every control a pill.
**Do** signal "available / done / selected" by lighting the cell (`blue-hi` → `blue` gradient, white glyph, 2.4s breathe), not by adding a badge or colour block.
**Do** draw any movement of information as a dotted `pathLength="100"` arc with a three-dot packet cluster travelling toward the receiver.
**Do** fill demo and pilot actions with `signal-strong` (#E5174B) and white text, with the demo glow underneath.
**Do** keep data text in `ice` and figures tabular; reserve pure white for headlines, lit-cell glyphs and emphasised values.
**Do** split dense instruments into hairline-divided rows inside one panel.
**Do** provide a lit still for every animated scene under reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** use red for alerts, deadlines, "now" markers, costs or counters; red is only Vous and the demo action.
**Don't** put a red fill on any control other than a demo or pilot request.
**Don't** add glows to buttons, text or panels beyond the demo pill and the closing wordmark; glow belongs to lit cells and packets.
**Don't** introduce a second white surface; paper is only the quote and its documents.
**Don't** nest cards inside cards; the report KPIs and feature details were rebuilt as rows for this reason.
**Don't** set display text in a system face; Poppins and Inter are self-hosted and are the only faces.
**Don't** place uppercase labels above section headings; uppercase data labels live only inside instruments.
